Notes: Karli Cappelleri, inside the crashed alien ship 8009 (AO-Universe Arete #20). Dialog from the guide; spot from Randy; solo turn-in guessed. Generated by ddogs/tools/Build-KarliAlienShip.ps1. Opener, "Why are you dressed up like that?" branch and Goodbye are the live dialog capture 2026-10-30 (RC-PC dialogs_20261030.csv); the "What are you doing?" branch (spy, missions, Friendly Buff) was not captured and stays guessed.

fight.Text: I want to fight aliens too!

nofriends.Text: But, I don't have any friends...

ready.Text: We are ready to help you out.

teamready.Text: My team is ready to storm the ship.

used.Text: I found a teammate and used the can on them.

s_hard.Text: Give us the mission the others are too chicken to take.

t_hard.Text: Give us the mission the others are too chicken to take.

dressed.Text: Why are you dressed up like that?

dead.Text: You know the aliens in this room are all dead, right?

teammates.Text: I need to get some teammates first.

spy.Text: I'm an alien spy. I find and terminate aliens... Quietly!

friends.Text: I think you should find some friends to help you out for this one.

Text: You know we have a lookup system to find people with similar interests here on Rubi-Ka. Just open your team search interface. Or perhaps just look for someone around you that you can start a team with.
{delay 1}Here, take this Friendly Buff Nano can and see if you can find a friend to use it on.

fb_back.Text: Did you find a friend for that Friendly Buff can?

Text: See? Rubi-Ka is friendlier with a team. Take these memory chips.
The Zix hides in the Alien General's room, deep inside the ship. Take this key and go through the Crashed Alien Ship door at the back of this room. Try not to blow my cover.
The General itself is holed up in the arena at the bottom of the ship, three decks down. Every one of your team gets the mission and a key; go through the Crashed Alien Ship door together.

solo_pick.Text: How tough do you want it?

team_pick.Text: How tough does your team want it?

Text: The crew is a bit below you. The Zix hides in the Alien General's room, deep inside the ship. Take this key and go through the Crashed Alien Ship door at the back of this room.
The crew is above you and the General is nasty. The Zix hides in its room, deep inside the ship. Take this key and go through the Crashed Alien Ship door at the back of this room.
Easy, then. The General waits in the arena three decks down, with two healing towers. Kill the towers first. Every one of your team gets the mission and a key.
Your funeral. The General waits in the arena three decks down, with two healing towers. Kill the towers first. Every one of your team gets the mission and a key.

camo.Text: It is the perfect camouflage. The aliens won't expect a thing. Move along now before I have to pretend to kill you!

quietly.Text: Yes, because I quietly killed them! Do you want to help a girl out or not?

letme.Text: Let me know... Now, leave me so you don't blow my cover.
